name: Lomita City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Tuesday, February 04, 2020 - 6:00 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation – Mayor Pro Tem Waronek
d.
Roll Call
e.
Closed Session Announcement – City Attorney
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
* CERTIFICATE OF RECOGNITION PRESENTED TO DETECTIVE DAVID PETERSON UPON HIS RETIREMENT FROM THE LA COUNTY SHERIFF'S DEPARTMENT
* CERTIFICATE OF RECOGNITION PRESENTED TO SGT. ROGER DIGERLANDO UPON HIS RETIREMENT FROM THE LA COUNTY SHERIFF'S DEPARTMENT
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council comments; however, items which are not on the agenda will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
6.
CITY MANAGER’S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Council Member or staff.
RECOMMENDED ACTION: That Consent Calendar Items 7 a-d be approved.
a.
Motion to waive full reading of ordinances and that they be read in title only
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Approve Motion.
b.
Approval of the Minutes of the Special Meeting of January 21, 2020
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Approve Minutes.
Item #7b
c.
Approval of Warrants/Payroll Register
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Approve and file Warrants/Payroll Register.
Item #7c
d.
Approval of a Professional Services Agreement with Quantum Quality Consulting, Inc. to Provide As-Needed Engineering Services
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Authorize the City Manager to execute a five-year agreement, with one five-year renewal option, with Quantum Quality Consulting (QQC), Inc. to provide as-needed professional engineering services. Estimated annual costs would be $70,000 (approximately $60,000 of which will be paid by project applicants).
Item #7d
PUBLIC HEARING
8.
PUBLIC HEARING - DISCUSSION AND CONSIDERATION TO ADOPT ORDINANCE NO. 806 RELATING TO THE ADOPTION OF REVISED STATE BUILDING CODES (SECOND READING)
Presented by Alicia Velasco, Community and Economic Development Director
RECOMMENDED ACTION: It is recommended that the City Council: 1) Open the Public Hearing; 2) Receive any public testimony; 3) Close the Public Hearing; 4) Waive further reading and adopt Ordinance No. 806, an Ordinance Adopting by Reference the 2020 Los Angeles County Building, Electrical, Plumbing, Mechanical, Residential, Existing Building, and Green Building Codes with Certain Amendments Necessitated by Local Conditions.
ORD NO. 806 - AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LOMITA, CALIFORNIA, CODE AMENDMENT NO. 2019-03 ADOPTING BY REFERENCE THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY CODE AMENDING LOMITA MUNICIPAL CODE SECTIONS 10-1 (BUILDING CODE), 10-2 (ELECTRICAL CODE), 10-3 (PLUMBING CODE), 10-4 (MECHANICAL CODE), 10-7 (RESIDENTIAL CODE), 10-8 (GREEN BUILDING STANDARDS), AND 10-9 (EXISTING BUILDING CODES) INCORPORATING THE CALIFORNIA BUILDING CODE, 2019 EDITION; TITLE 26 OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY BUILDING CODE; TITLE 27 OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY CODE, INCORPORATING THE CALIFORNIA ELECTRICAL CODE, 2019 EDITION; TITLE 28 OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY CODE, INCORPORATING THE CALIFORNIA PLUMBING CODE, 2019 EDITION; TITLE 29 OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY CODE, INCORPORATING THE CALIFORNIA MECHANICAL CODE, 2019 EDITION; TITLE 30 OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY CODE, INCORPORATING THE CALIFORNIA RESIDENTIAL CODE, 2019 EDITION; TITLE 31 OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY CODE, INCORPORATING THE CALIFORNIA GREEN BUILDING STANDARDS CODE, 2019 EDITION, AND TITLE 33 OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY CODE, INCORPORATING THE CALIFORNIA EXISTING BUILDING CODE, 2019 EDITION WITH CERTAIN CHANGES AND MODIFICATIONS, AND MAKING OTHER REVISIONS THERETO
Item #8
9.
ADJOURNMENT The next regular meeting will be held on Tuesday, February 18, 2020, at 6:00 p.m. in the Council Chambers of City Hall, located at 24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA.
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting at the following locations: Lomita City Hall lobby and outside bulletin board, Lomita Parks and Recreation, and uploaded to the City of Lomita website http://www.lomita.com/cityhall/city_agendas/.
Date Posted: January 31, 2020
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
